holistic: Judge the exact visual question using only visible evidence. Return JSON only: {"premise_consistency":"supported|unsupported|uncertain","reference_clarity":"clear|ambiguous|not_applicable|uncertain","visual_answerability":"answerable|unanswerable|uncertain","raw_reason":"short"}. A yes/no question can be valid when No; a count can be zero; the queried property is not a premise.
flat: First extract a flat list of presuppositions, reference constraints, and one query target from the question. Do not assume an object exists for yes/no or count questions. Then verify each against the image. Return JSON only: {"presuppositions":[{"text":"...","label":"supported|unsupported|uncertain"}],"reference_constraints":[{"text":"...","label":"clear|ambiguous|uncertain"}],"query_target":{"text":"...","label":"answerable|unanswerable|uncertain"},"raw_reason":"short"}.
